dataset: NHAMCS 2022 Emergency Department Public Use File
publisher: National Center for Health Statistics, CDC
survey_period: Calendar year 2022; each sampled hospital reports visits during a randomly assigned 4-week reporting period
population: Visits to emergency departments of noninstitutional general and short-stay hospitals, excluding Federal, military and VA hospitals, in the 50 US states and DC
missing_data_assumption: Records with special codes are excluded from the estimate that needs that variable (complete-case within variable). This assumes the excluded visits resemble the included ones after weighting; IMMEDR has 27.8 % documented item nonresponse and WAITTIME 14.1 %.
weighting: All shares, means and quantiles use PATWT; per-ED volumes use EDWT.
variance: Taylor linearization with CSTRATM and CPSUM (with-replacement ultimate clusters; singleton strata centred on the overall mean). 95 % intervals use a normal approximation. Quantiles have no SE.
reliability_rule: reliable = at least 30 records and relative standard error <= 30 %. This is a simplified screen, not the complete NCHS 2017 proportion criteria.

nhamcs_2022_hourly_profile.csv.content: Share of daily visits by arrival hour (ARRTIME)

nhamcs_2022_triage_profile.csv.content: Share of triaged visits by IMMEDR level 1-5

nhamcs_2022_reference_volume.csv.content: Annual and daily visits per ED (mean and EDWT-weighted quantiles)
nhamcs_2022_reference_volume.csv.unit: visits per ED per year / per day

nhamcs_2022_reference_metrics.csv.content: WAITTIME mean, median, p90 and share > 60 min, overall, by triage and by 4-hour arrival block
nhamcs_2022_reference_metrics.csv.use: validation target only; must not be used to fit model parameters

nhamcs_2022_service_proxy.csv.content: LOV - WAITTIME - BOARDED by triage (post-contact time)
nhamcs_2022_service_proxy.csv.use: upper-bound reference; not adopted as team occupancy

service_medians_minutes.reason: LOV includes tests, results, internal waits and boarding; it does not measure the time a single team is occupied.

scope_limitation: NHAMCS is a national US reference. It does not describe a specific Guatemalan hospital and cannot show that an intervention was applied or improved real outcomes.
